dialect.detail: ACUCOBOL-GT / Micro Focus Visual COBOL with TOTEM framework (Italian ERP/order management system 'GESLUX EDI'). Uses ACUCOBOL-specific extensions: HANDLE OF WINDOW, HANDLE OF FONT, HANDLE OF STATUS-BAR, COMP-4, CRT STATUS, SPECIAL-NAMES CRT STATUS, 78-level constants, WHEN SET TO FALSE, XFD directives.

purpose.domain_detail: Italian wholesale/distribution ERP system (GESLUX EDI) - EDI order import and management for orders from clients, handling promotions, pricing, stock, agents, payment terms, and logistics
purpose.summary: EDI-selordini is a large batch/interactive COBOL program generated by the TOTEM framework for the GESLUX EDI system. It handles the selection, import, and management of EDI purchase orders, including validation of articles, pricing, promotions, stock levels, customer credit limits (fido), and order status management. The program interfaces with numerous master files (clients, destinations, articles, warehouses, price lists, etc.) via COPY-based file definitions.

notable_features: TOTEM code generator framework (generated file with TOTEM markers)
XFD directives for ACUCOBOL file system
WHEN SET TO FALSE on 88-level items
138 COPY statements for modular file/record definitions
GUI screen handling (CRT STATUS, toolbar bitmaps, grid controls)
verdict.notes: File is explicitly marked as generated by TOTEM framework ('This is a generated file. DO NOT modify this file directly.'). Source is in Italian. The program is part of a commercial Italian ERP/distribution system called GESLUX EDI. Source truncated to first 16000 chars but mechanical indicators confirm full file is ~807KB/23233 lines. No EXEC SQL or EXEC CICS present; GUI is ACUCOBOL thin-client style.
